items.headline: Victoria Beckham Returns to Gap for Fall Collection
items.blurb: Collaboration signals continued demand for celebrity-designer partnerships and heritage denim silhouettes in seasonal collections.

items.headline: Lab-Grown Leather Innovator Qorium Relaunch as Reyva Targets Luxury Market

items.headline: Industry Coalition Advances Safer Denim Finishing Standards

items.headline: Denim Labels Unveil Festive Collection Strategies

items.headline: French Recycler Reju Scales Up Regenerated Polyester Production
items.blurb: Design teams can now source sustainable alternatives, but brands must actively participate in closed-loop systems to make circular textiles viable at scale.
